testcase.name: the loop reads its full retrace until the rim is regained, never the chord
at 12 m the switchback reads the report's 228 m through more joins
a return leg beside the outbound one falls at every point at 10 m and rises at every point at 0 m
measured cost at 135, 1000 and 2880 points - printed for the report, equal to the naive scan
on the return leg the way home decreases at every point and reaches zero at the car
the distant walker's outbound track is the full retrace at 10 m - and would not be at 12
parallel legs join at 9 point 5 m apart and not at 10 point 5
the patch collapses to its straight line at 10 m
a patch 100 m from the car reads the approach plus the straight line
one point is a zero-length way home, and a negative epsilon is refused
the grid scan finds the same joins and distance as the all-pairs scan
the switchback closes at 10 m and not below - the floor the constant sits on
measured lateral offset at which the join stops firing at 10 m - printed for the report
